The '''Sy Myrth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]].
